sessionStart.bash: if [ -f .planning/STATE.md ]; then echo '📋 GSD Project detected. Current state:'; head -20 .planning/STATE.md; fi
sessionStart.powershell: if (Test-Path .planning/STATE.md) { Write-Host '📋 GSD Project detected. Current state:'; Get-Content .planning/STATE.md -Head 20 }

postToolUse.bash: if [ -f .planning/STATE.md ] && [ "$COPILOT_TOOL_NAME" = "write" ]; then echo '💡 Reminder: Update .planning/STATE.md if this affects project state'; fi
postToolUse.powershell: if ((Test-Path .planning/STATE.md) -and ($env:COPILOT_TOOL_NAME -eq 'write')) { Write-Host '💡 Reminder: Update .planning/STATE.md if this affects project state' }
